dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every probability space and measurable real-valued function, the exponential-square Orlicz gauge equals the psi-two gauge, and finiteness of the first is equivalent to finiteness of the second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the complete target proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ENNReal infimum of the admissible scales for a bundled Orlicz function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the first quantity in the equality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finiteness of the Orlicz gauge, expressed by strict inequality below ENNReal infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the left side of the finiteness equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The bundled function x ↦ exp(x^2) - 1 with the required Orlicz-function properties.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the exponential-square Orlicz function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ENNReal infimum of positive finite scales whose exponential-square moment is integrable and at most 2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the second quantity in the equality and equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: A real function bundled with nonnegativity, convexity, monotonicity, zero value, and divergence properties on the nonnegative domain.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the mathematical structure of the gauge function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor exposing the fields required to build the bundled Orlicz function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the bundled function's required axioms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scale-admissibility predicate: nonzero, finite, and Orlicz integral at most 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the first infimum's set of scales.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: Nonnegativity of exp(x^2) - 1 for nonnegative x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the selected Orlicz function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Convexity of exp(x^2) - 1 on the nonnegative half-line.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the selected Orlicz function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Monotonicity of exp(x^2) - 1 on the nonnegative half-line.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the selected Orlicz function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The identity exp(0^2) - 1 = 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the selected Orlicz function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Divergence of exp(x^2) - 1 to infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the selected Orlicz function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The psi-two scale predicate requiring measurability, positive finite scale, integrability, and exponential-square moment at most 2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the second infimum's set of scales.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative Lebesgue integral of ψ(|X|/t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the modular bound in the first scale predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Numeral elaboration evidence for the constant 2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the threshold 2 without changing the mathematical claim.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection from a bundled Orlicz function to its underlying real function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Evaluates ψ inside the modular.

binders: An arbitrary type Ω with a measurable-space structure.
A measure μ on Ω carrying a probability-measure instance.
A real-valued function X : Ω → ℝ.
conclusions: For ψ(x)=exp(x^2)-1, the ENNReal infimum of nonzero finite scales t with ∫⁻ ofReal(ψ(|X|/t.toReal)) dμ ≤ 1 equals the ENNReal infimum of nonzero finite scales t for which exp(X^2/t.toReal^2) is integrable and its real integral is at most 2.
The first gauge is finite exactly when the second exponential-moment gauge is finite.
mathematical_definitions: ψ is the bundled Orlicz function x ↦ exp(x^2)-1, certified nonnegative, convex, and nondecreasing on [0,∞), zero at zero, and divergent at infinity.
The Orlicz gauge is the infimum of nonzero finite ENNReal scales satisfying the modular threshold 1.
The comparison gauge is the infimum of nonzero finite ENNReal scales satisfying measurability, integrability, and the exponential-square moment threshold 2.
Finiteness means strict inequality below ENNReal infinity.
translation.proposition_plain_english: On every probability space, for every measurable real-valued X, the Luxemburg gauge generated by exp(x^2)-1 is exactly the exponential-square gauge with moment threshold 2, and the two finite-gauge classes coincide.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem requires a probability measure and a measurable real-valued function.
Both scale predicates exclude zero and infinity, so every denominator is positive and finite.
Both quantities are ENNReal infima; the target does not separately assert that an admissible set is nonempty or that its infimum is attained.
The second predicate explicitly includes integrability of the exponential integrand.
No centering or mean-zero hypothesis is imposed.
The target is stated for raw functions rather than quotient classes, but both quantities are almost-everywhere invariant.
ambiguities: The blind dossier exposes only the type, not the defining field, of IsProbabilityMeasure; its conventional meaning is total mass one.
The internal constructors of Nat.AtLeastTwo are omitted, although this affects only elaboration of the literal 2.
